notes: v5: v4 variable set on the honest (as-available, expected-to-play) frame; equal-weight average of extra-trees LightGBM (10 and 25 per leaf), standard LightGBM and CatBoost; official = rank average with the FantasyPros weekly consensus
range_adjust_note: Oct 11, 2026: high end widened by k around the official projection, low end lowered by c points; fit on the 2023-2026 walk-forward (walk-forward check: about 10% of games beyond each end, from about 12%)

qb_market.note: v5.1 (Oct 12, 2026): projected starting QBs ranked by 30% model + 70% market projection (Vegas implied team points x the QB's recent share of team skill-position fantasy points in his starts) plus a cold-start offset by prior starts (fit on the 2022-2026 walk-forward); the model's own QB points are handed out in that order within the week.

ros.note: ROS (Oct 12, 2026): points = this week's official projection + games after this week x per-game rate; rate = 0.8 x this week's projection + 0.2 x the ROS rate model (players out or on bye: the ROS rate model alone); official = 50/50 rank average with the FantasyPros ROS rank, model points handed out in that order; ranges from 10th/90th percentile rate models, scaled per position (low, high) on validation seasons. Chosen on 2020-2022 walk-forward, tested on 2023-2025.

avail.note: Share of his team's remaining games (snapshot week through Week 17) a player actually played, 2020-2025 snapshots weeks 3-14, players the experts ranked (QB32 / RB60 / WR80 / TE32). active = projected this week; out = not projected this week; res = on IR / reserve.

big_games.note: Chance of a 400+ passing / 150+ rushing / 175+ receiving yard game given the player's long-run average (logistic on log of the average), fit on 2018-2025 played games; for leagues with yardage bonuses.

value.note: Undervalued / at value / overvalued (trade analyzer): our model's ROS points minus the points our model gives the player at his FantasyPros ROS consensus rank (same position, same week), per game left; >= +1.0 undervalued, <= -1.0 overvalued. Threshold chosen on 2020-2022 walk-forward snapshots (weeks 3-14) from 0.25-2.5; test 2023-2025: undervalued players finished above their market rank 56% of the time (+0.6 PPR per game vs the points at that rank), at value 41% (-0.8), overvalued 30% (-2.4); same order every season and position.
